progress.badge: HOW WE GOT TO THIS POINT
progress.title: Progress towards the mission

content.problem1: Traditional site analysis took months, scattered across reports, maps, and spreadsheets.
content.solution1: We built the SiteSynergy Engine to unify solar, grid, land, and infrastructure data into one workflow — without slowing down decision-making.
content.problem2: Site selection needed structured insight, not just raw data
content.solution2: Raw datasets weren't enough. We developed models to automatically classify, filter, and preserve only meaningful context across diverse geospatial and technical sources.
content.problem3: Making this work at scale was a massive challenge
content.solution3: We engineered real-time, offline-capable pipelines for geospatial ingestion and analysis — enabling instant site scoring and risk assessment without reliance on cloud-heavy processes.
content.breakthrough: Key Breakthrough: First real-time, privacy-preserving site selection engine that could capture, structure, and process multi-layer geospatial data without manual effort — cutting timelines from months to less than a day.

content.problem1: Raw site data wasn't enough — the system needed to identify which sites to prioritize, which to discard, and how to retrieve the right insights instantly.
content.solution1: We built adaptive scoring and filtering models to surface the most promising sites while removing noise — a challenge no other site selection tool had solved at scale.

subPhase.title: Balanced quality & quantity (Automation-2)
subPhase.problem2: Individual site scores lacked context — site evaluation needed to "connect the dots" across multiple factors.
subPhase.solution2: At scale, insights became fragmented. Inspired by layered analysis, we built continuous linking across solar yield, grid capacity, land use, and permitting constraints — giving developers cohesive, end-to-end evaluations.
subPhase.problem3: Efficiency was a massive barrier — real-time & long-term analysis had to be lightweight.
subPhase.solution3: We achieved dramatic efficiency gains, boosting accuracy and granularity while cutting compute needs — enabling nation-scale analysis in a fraction of the time and cost.
subPhase.breakthrough: Key Breakthrough: First real-time, privacy-preserving site selection engine that could deliver automated, highly accurate, and scalable analysis — turning months of fragmented work into a single-day, data-driven decision.
